big_case.notes: Follow-on FAAAA preemption petition from an unpublished California Court of Appeal decision, no cert-stage amici, resolved by a routine unsigned GVR in light of Montgomery v. Caribe Transport II. Question 2 (whether shippers/receivers can invoke s. 14501(c)(1) at all) has real sector-wide stakes for freight and tort plaintiffs, but the Court did not take it; the order itself makes no law.
